title: Ratio Calculator
h1: Ratio Calculator — Simplify and Scale Ratios
seoTitle: Free Ratio Calculator — Simplify Ratios Online
description: Simplify ratios like 12:18 to 2:3 or scale a ratio to a new value. Useful for recipes, mixtures and proportions. Private browser calculation.
intro: Enter two numbers to simplify their ratio, or provide a third value to find the missing part of a proportion.
blurb: Simplify ratios and solve proportions instantly.
howItWorks: Enter the two numbers of the ratio.
Choose simplify to reduce the fraction, or scale to solve for the missing value.
Results update when you press Calculate. GCD is used for exact simplification.
examples: If 3 parts sugar to 5 parts flour, and you have 150 g sugar, you need 250 g flour.
Useful for mixing paint, scaling recipes or map scales.
